import sys
import math

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, n = map(int, data[:3])
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    x //= g
    y //= g
    if n >= y:
        print(f"{x}/{y}")
        return
    target = x / y
    bestError = target
    ans = [0] * n
    bestDen = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        h = i * target
        low = int(math.floor(h))
        errLow = abs(low / i - target)
        errHigh = abs((low + 1) / i - target)
        if bestError > errLow or bestError > errHigh:
            if errLow > errHigh:
                ans[i - 1] = low + 1
                bestDen = i
                bestError = errHigh
            else:
                ans[i - 1] = low
                bestDen = i
                bestError = errLow
    print(f"{ans[bestDen - 1]}/{bestDen}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
